---
applyTo: "content/**/*.md"
---

# Content editing instructions

- Preserve Josh's conversational and direct voice.
- Do not rewrite sections solely to make them sound more polished or corporate.
- Correct obvious grammar and structural problems while retaining personality.
- Preserve existing frontmatter unless the task requires changing it.
- Do not invent dates, book details, quotes, links, ratings, or factual claims.
- Keep Markdown source readable and reasonably wrapped.
- Use sentence case for headings unless an established content series differs.
- Use descriptive alt text for meaningful images.
- Preserve existing published URLs and slugs.
- Prefer ordinary Markdown to embedded Vue components.
- Check internal links when moving or renaming content.
